decisions.reason: Google Analytics 4 is the current analytics standard, so the plugin retains option value while demand uncertainty resolves and its carrying cost is low.
Universal Analytics was discontinued by Google, so the option has resolved and no longer justifies any further commitment.
The retail system interface plugin's prospects remain uncertain and its carrying cost is likely low, so the option is worth retaining.
The shop relaunch SEO support service is presented on its own page, indicating unresolved demand and sufficient option value to keep given the firm has few other new options.
